## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Broad equity participation (SPY (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND) contrasts with largely flat macro ratios (VXX (1W: -12.50% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND vs HYG (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND), supporting a neutral stance.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress EASING: HYG (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND. Fear dynamics mixed but easing: VXX (1W: -12.50% | 1M: -9.85%) BELOW TREND while SPY/TLT neutral with TLT (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: UUP (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION; LQD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY; TLT (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and tech leading: XLF (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging on 1W weakness: XLE (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) CORRECTION.

**5. US vs Global?**
US strength intact: SPY (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%) ABOVE TREND; EM leadership visible: EEM (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +2.73%) ABOVE TREND; China showing selective recovery: FXI (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -0.82%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows healthy but selective: IBIT (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +3.02%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%) ABOVE TREND; ARKK (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -5.45%) RECOVERY.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed commodity regime: USO (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +19.93%) ABOVE TREND showing oil strength while BNO (1W: -3.60% | 1M: +11.87%) CORRECTION and CPER (1W: +2.53% | 1M: -2.41%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed to weaker on the week: XLE (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) CORRECTION; UNG (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%) BELOW TREND; USO (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +19.93%) ABOVE TREND remains the outlier.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity leadership with SPY (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND; credit steady with HYG (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: TLT (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY and XLE (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) CORRECTION create a minor cross-asset split to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposures showing strength: XLK (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +2.73%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy nat-gas complex XLE (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral — monitor TLT (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology/semis — XLK (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy — XLE (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil exposure via USO (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +19.93%) ABOVE TREND and watch CPER (1W: +2.53% | 1M: -2.41%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%) BELOW TREND and watch safe-haven GLD (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -8.36%) RECOVERY for further weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency trigger), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health gauge), XLK/XLF spread ~1.2 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, broad equity participation but macro ratios largely flat. Technology and semiconductors showing strength (XLK, SOXX), while energy/nat-gas divergence (XLE, UNG) and TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) are the key risks to monitor.
